clickies.description:
This effect absorbs most spells cast by beholder eye stalks. Only a few such
spells can be absorbed before the item ceases to function and must have time to
dissipate the absorbed energy.
clickies.name: Absorb Beholder Spells

clickies.description:
This effect absorbs the standard spells, spells from beholder and doomsphere eye beams.
A charge is expended for each eye beam absorbed.
clickies.name: Absorb Beholder and Doomsphere Spells
